title: Surexport
description: surexport.es Surexport is the largest independent berry producer in Europe, founded in 1994 in Huelva, Spain, growing strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries across Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Morocco and Kenya. Owned since 2020 by Alantra Private Equity, the group is valued at around 600 million euros with revenue approaching 400 million and over 2500 employees. Its competitive edge is exclusive berry varieties developed with US genetics partner Plant Sciences since 2007, sold under the Doñarosa, Berry Sensations and Fruhi brands. Major clients include Tesco, Lidl, Mercadona and Sainsbury's, with 80 percent of revenue from exports to Northern Europe. The company invested 200 million euros in acquisitions and secured a 250 million euro loan in 2025.
